title: Comporta configuration
description: Single-file gateway configuration. Relational rules, such as model references and hard caps, are enforced by `comporta config validate`.

storage.description: Where usage history and shared state live. SQLite is the default for a single instance; distributed mode needs postgres and redis.

backend.description: postgres requires deployment.mode distributed. Changing it requires a restart and an empty destination.

max_connections.description: Per process. Multiply by the replicas to size the server.

address.description: One standalone endpoint as host:port, without credentials. Sentinel and Cluster are not supported.

username.description: ACL user name. Not a secret.

enabled.description: Only a loopback address may disable TLS.

ca_file.description: CA bundle that signs the server certificate. The host name is always verified.

server_name.description: Expected certificate name when it differs from the address host.

deployment.description: How many processes share this gateway. Several replicas need mode distributed.

replicas.description: Declared replica count. With SQLite, more than 1 aborts startup.

cluster_id.description: Stable and immutable cluster name. Required in distributed mode.

config_revision.description: Positive revision shared by every replica. Raise it to roll out a change; never lower it.

hmac_key_file.description: File with exactly 32 bytes used to pseudonymize users, mounted from one shared secret.

cursor_key_file.description: File with exactly 32 bytes that signs usage cursors. Must differ from hmac_key_file.

data_dir.description: Data directory, relative to this file. Default: ./data. Changing it requires a restart.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for budgets. Default: system timezone, which must have an IANA identifier.

fail_mode.description: Behavior when limit state is unavailable. Default: fail_closed.

providers.description: Upstream providers by name. At least one is required.

pricing.description: Price overrides by declared model ID. An override replaces the whole entry.

max_bytes.description: Memory budget of the response cache, in decimal bytes, shared by every app. Default and maximum: 256000000.

secretRef.description: Environment reference that fills the whole value, such as ${API_KEY}. Literal values are rejected.

secretFile.description: Secret file, relative to this file. Reread when the configuration is saved.

base_url.description: Absolute URL without credentials, query or fragment. Plain HTTP only for localhost, loopback or private IP literals.

models.description: Model IDs. Each ID must be unique across all providers.

tls_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version, as a quoted string. Default: 1.2.

bind.description: IP address. Default: 127.0.0.1. Changing it requires a restart.

port.description: Default: 8080 for proxy, 8081 for admin. Changing it requires a restart.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts added to the base list localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1]. No wildcards, URLs or paths.

max_concurrent.description: Default: 20 for an app, 4 per user.

hardCap.description: Ceiling per budget dimension that blocks every new generation whatever on_limit says, including requests that cost nothing once the cap is reached. Each dimension needs a matching budget and must be at least that budget. With on_limit downgrade, omitted dimensions default to 120%, rounded up. With on_limit warn and no hard_cap, there is no financial ceiling at all: rate, token and concurrency limits still apply. With fail_mode fail_open, the cap is not guaranteed while limit state is unavailable.

allowed_models.description: Declared models this app may use. Requests for any other model get HTTP 403 model_not_allowed, and a downgrade never turns a forbidden model into an allowed one.

max_tokens.description: Output cap per request. Larger values are lowered to it; a request in OpenAI format without an output limit gets it injected. Default: 4096.

on_limit.description: What happens when a calendar budget is exceeded. block answers 429 with the limit name and renewal time. downgrade sends downgrade_to instead and stops at hard_cap. warn forwards the request, marks it warned and emits an event; without hard_cap it has no financial ceiling. Rate, token and concurrency limits always block. Default: block.

downgrade_to.description: Required for on_limit downgrade. Must be allowed and have a known price. Switching models changes the safety behavior the app sees; configuring a target means accepting that trade-off. A lower price is never inferred from the name. Requests in another API format than the target are blocked at the limit until cross-provider translation exists.

fallback.description: Ordered fallback chain of allowed models of the same API format, tried after 429, 5xx, connection errors or timeouts before anything reaches the client. Default: empty.

shared_across_users.description: Default: false. Enabling it can expose personal content of one user to another.

rehydrate.description: Default: false. Applies only to non-streaming responses.

channels.description: Alert channels by name. A channel is enabled by being present.

server_url.description: Server URL without credentials, query or fragment.

metrics_enabled.description: Default: true. Exposes GET /metrics on the admin listener, behind the admin token; when false it answers 404 and stops counting, keeping the values counted so far.

otel_enabled.description: Default: false. When true, otel_endpoint is required and every proxy request produces one trace exported over OTLP/HTTP protobuf.

otel_endpoint.description: Base URL of an OTLP/HTTP receiver, without credentials, query or fragment; /v1/traces is appended unless the path already ends with it. Plain http is only accepted for localhost, loopback or private IP literals and single-label service names such as http://jaeger:4318; use https otherwise.
